sources.scope: mini-app ad formats and UX policy

strategy.rationale: The public tool route produces a complete local-only result before the dormant sponsor boundary, but the proposed placement remains prohibited until same-revision browser evidence proves that publisher-content boundary and the traffic, quality, privacy, sponsor-contract and release-wave gates all close. Direct self-sold sponsorship remains only a selected future web direction, isolated from network advertising and paid acquisition.
strategy.activationGate: owner-approved release wave after a direct sponsor contract, release flag and campaign read-back, privacy review, route QA, impression reconciliation and rollback drill

futureSurfaceReview.rejudgeNote: 2026-08-27 재검토: ToolPage → WebTool → SponsorSlot 순서를 다시 읽었다. 성공한 로컬 worker 결과 뒤에만 first-value event가 나고, 공개 경로는 PUBLIC_SPONSOR_RELEASE_APPROVED가 정확히 true이며 직접 sponsor provider가 있을 때만 DOM을 보일 수 있다. 현재 registry의 productionActivated=false·surface prohibited와 same-revision browser/계약/release-wave gate는 그대로다; payload·계정·결제·순위 대상 전송이나 provider 활성화는 추가하지 않았다.

surfaces.rationale: A usable local product result exists independently before this dormant boundary, and the component is source-gated to zero layout footprint before first value with no payload targeting or ranking effect. The surface is nevertheless prohibited because no same-revision browser journey currently proves the actual /:tool completed-result boundary; traffic and quality thresholds, privacy review, a direct sponsor contract, test-ad QA, reconciliation, rollback and owner-approved release-wave evidence also remain open.

publisherContent.screenPurpose: A public local-only decoding tool screen that returns a complete usable result without transmitting the input.

independentValueCompletion.description: WebTool renders the successful worker result and only then dispatches the first-value event consumed by the dormant below-fold sponsor boundary.

publisherContent.contentFocalPoint: The decoded, encoded, hashed or inspected result produced from the visitor's local input.

browserEvidence.remainingGate: Record a clean-profile same-source web journey for /:tool that completes a local operation, shows the result before the below-fold boundary, and proves zero ad request before explicit release approval.

surfaces.rationale: Input, the first local result, result ordering, and every non-web channel remain sponsor-free.
